content_blocks.title: Work through the example
content_blocks.text: Read the small example, predict every output line, then run it locally with a compatible runtime. `os.clock` measures CPU time on supported runtimes; repeat benchmarks and do not rely on a single measurement. Keep the smallest reproducible case if the observed behavior differs.

content_blocks.code:
local started = os.clock()
local total = 0
for i = 1, 1000 do total = total + i end
local elapsed = os.clock() - started
print(total)
print(elapsed >= 0)
